branchName.instructions: Use feat/ and fix/ etc.. prefixes for branch names.

commitMessage.instructions:
Use conventional commits. 
Keep the long text of commit messages very concise.

pullRequest.instructions:
The PR title should follow conventional commit format.

Start with a concise summary of the changes that were made.
Callout any issues that were accounted for during the implementation plan.
Describe what steps were taken to verify the change
